summary: Frontend testing of My Files tab redesign. All 6 requested features verified with screenshots. Full onboarding → login → My Files navigation flow tested successfully.

features_verified.filter_bar: ✓ All 5 filter chips visible (All, Active, Paused, Archived, Trash) below the tab tabs
features_verified.number_badges: ✓ #1, #2, #3... visible on each active case card (top-left badge)
features_verified.action_menu_button: ✓ ··· (ellipsis) button visible bottom-right of each card alongside Continue button
features_verified.action_menu_sheet: ✓ Tapping ··· opens bottom sheet with: Archive, Save to device, Move to trash, Delete permanently

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured. STACK_THRESHOLD=3 correctly groups 3+ same-title items.
ItemState persisted in AsyncStorage per user - good approach.
actionsFor() correctly returns different actions based on current filter (Active/Archived/Trash)
